mapper.sql: UCID, UID, CHID, StartTime, EndTime, Status, Remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM userlearns WHERE UID = #{uid} AND CHID = #{chid} ORDER BY UCID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM userlearns WHERE UID = #{uid} AND Status = 1 ORDER BY UCID DESC

SELECT c.CUID AS cuid, c.CourseName AS courseName, c.Teacher AS teacher, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters ch2 WHERE ch2.CUID = c.CUID AND ch2.Status = 1) AS totalChapters, COUNT(DISTINCT ul.CHID) AS learnedChapters, (SELECT ch3.CHID FROM userlearns ul3 INNER JOIN chapters ch3 ON ul3.CHID = ch3.CHID AND ch3.Status = 1 WHERE ul3.UID = #{uid} AND ul3.Status = 1 AND ch3.CUID = c.CUID ORDER BY ul3.StartTime DESC, ul3.UCID DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastChapterId, (SELECT ch3.ChapterName FROM userlearns ul3 INNER JOIN chapters ch3 ON ul3.CHID = ch3.CHID AND ch3.Status = 1 WHERE ul3.UID = #{uid} AND ul3.Status = 1 AND ch3.CUID = c.CUID ORDER BY ul3.StartTime DESC, ul3.UCID DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastChapterName, (SELECT MAX(ul3.StartTime) FROM userlearns ul3 INNER JOIN chapters ch3 ON ul3.CHID = ch3.CHID AND ch3.Status = 1 WHERE ul3.UID = #{uid} AND ul3.Status = 1 AND ch3.CUID = c.CUID) AS finishTime FROM userlearns ul INNER JOIN chapters ch ON ul.CHID = ch.CHID AND ch.Status = 1 INNER JOIN courses c ON ch.CUID = c.CUID AND c.Status = 1 WHERE ul.UID = #{uid} AND ul.Status = 1 GROUP BY c.CUID, c.CourseName, c.Teacher ORDER BY finishTime DESC

SELECT ul.UCID, ul.UID, ul.CHID, ul.StartTime, ul.EndTime, ul.Status, ul.Remark, u.UserName AS userName, c.CourseName AS courseName, ch.ChapterName AS chapterName FROM userlearns ul INNER JOIN users u ON ul.UID = u.UID INNER JOIN chapters ch ON ul.CHID = ch.CHID INNER JOIN courses c ON ch.CUID = c.CUID WHERE ul.Status = 1 ORDER BY ul.UCID DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM userlearns WHERE Status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO userlearns (UID, CHID, Status) VALUES (#{uid}, #{chid}, #{status})
